body_markdown:
***TL;DR***


*As AI reshapes marketing, brands that build their tech stacks from modular, swappable tools can adopt new capabilities faster than those locked into a single suite. The rapid pace of innovation has made it more important than ever for brands to evolve their customer engagement efforts by taking a composable approach. Braze is built for composability, so you can bring in the latest AI and data tools without starting over. Seamless connections with other leading technologies, real-time streaming data infrastructure, and personalized message sending at a massive scale meet you where you are, and grow as your needs evolve.*


***Key takeaways***


- *As AI and other technologies rapidly advance, brands that find themselves unable to quickly embrace new capabilities and upgrade to more innovative solutions run the risk of falling behind the market and failing to serve their customers’ needs*
- *Composability can have a business impact, with 78% of companies with a mature approach to composability reporting ROI from their AI use, versus 13% of other companies*
- *Braze is committed to a composable ecosystem that gives you flexibility across your existing tools, data sources, and partner solutions. However you design your tech stack, Braze is built to support your goals today and in the future, so you can adopt modern AI and data tools without having to rebuild your stack*


Ask ten marketing teams what's in their tech stack and you'll get ten different answers. A retail brand may need different tools to manage inventory, while a fintech organization might need a solution to track account structures and currency changes. The stack that works for you is simply the one built to fit your customers, your company goals, and the way your teams need to operate. No matter how much technology advances, these key differences mean that there will never be one platform capable of meeting every business’ needs. Composability is how you build for those differences, and how you keep up as they evolve.


At Braze, we have always led with[composability](https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/composability-marketing-tech-stack-guide) as a core value. By embracing flexibility and interoperability, we’re able to deliver a platform that works with the data, tools, and partners you rely on today and that can swiftly adapt to handle changing customer preferences and technological advances. And with AI changing what’s possible every few months, the adaptability has become a critical part to driving results. So, what does composability mean for you as marketers, and why does it matter? Let’s dig in.


## What composability means for marketers


At its core, composability means that you can design flexible, scalable systems using modular components that meet your business’ specific needs; so each piece can be chosen, upgraded, and replaced on its own. That modularity pays off quickly. Your teams can adopt new capabilities when they're ready, on their own timeline. You can consolidate overlapping tools and reduce costs without a complete rip-and-replace project. And because every component works from the same open standards, data and insights move freely between teams.


Often brands choose an all-in-one, monolithic solution in the hopes of finding efficiency and simplicity. Instead, they usually end up with a rigid and expensive ecosystem, one that results in lower efficiency and higher complexity. Even worse, embracing this monolithic approach can significantly slow down innovation and lead to technical gaps. After all, when one suite has to do everything that a marketing team requires, upgrading a single capability can mean waiting around for the whole system to catch up, allowing other, more agile competitors to lap you.


On the other hand, composable stacks offer brands the opportunity to innovate quickly. You pick the best tool for each job, connect them to each other, and then swap them out when something better comes along. It’s simple, effective, and forward-looking.


## Why composability matters now


As AI and other technologies rapidly advance, new models, agents and protocols arrive every few months and the brands brands that that build with composable principles move faster and drive better results: Earlier this year, the[MACH Alliance](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-joins-mach-alliance-powering-the-future-of-composable-technology) , an industry body overseeing technology standards for composability (Braze has been a member since 2024), reported that[78% of companies](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260218812462/en/) with mature composable technology report concrete ROI from their use of AI, versus 13% of those who had not taken a composable approach.


## Composability offers three key benefits for brands:


1. **Interoperability:** When systems can't easily share data, information reaches the right people when they need to take action. Composable solutions allow teams to share insights across departments, validate impact, and identify new opportunities. This is even more important as headless AI approaches become more common. These are AI assistants, agents and models that connect to your systems through APIs and open protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so they can work wherever your team already does. A marketer might ask an AI assistant to pull last week's campaign results without anyone opening a dashboard. That only works when every tool in your stack is open enough to connect and communicate with each other.


2. **Flexibility:** Technology moves quickly, and what serves your business best today may need to adapt as the needs of your customers and your business shift. A modular setup gives you the freedom to swap in newer, more effective tools whenever you need them, keeping your ecosystem fresh and optimized without having to rebuild the entire thing from scratch.


3. **Scalability:** Some technologies work great to reach a million users, but struggle at 5 or 10 million. Expanding your reach from early adopters to millions of active users requires infrastructure that stays reliable under heavy demand. Composability can give you a resilient foundation right from the start, allowing you to build a secure and scalable stack for growth without having to compromise on speed or impact.


## How Braze supports composability


Braze is designed to work alongside your existing tools, data sources, and partner solutions so your teams can act on a complete, current picture of every customer. We prioritize partnerships that help you solve real customer use cases, so you can adopt modern AI and data tools without having to rebuild your stack.


### First-party context layer for your AI tools


AI is only as good as the context it runs on. A model that can't see a customer's latest purchase, session, or support ticket will make generic decisions. The[Braze Data Platform](https://www.braze.com/product/braze-data-platform) (BDP) is a composable, first-party context layer for AI on Braze. It brings together customer data from the sources you choose, keeps it current, and makes it available across Braze through campaigns, Canvases, Catalogs, BrazeAI Operator, BrazeAI Agent Console and more. Engagement data then flows back to destinations of your choice, making it possible to successfully drive business intelligence in your source of truth.


Braze is built on a patented[stream processing engine](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/ultimate-guide-to-data-streaming-technologies) , so the platform acts on data as it comes in. Marketers can access the data they need in real time to orchestrate cross-channel experiences using APIs, SDKs,[Cloud Data Ingestion](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/data/unification/cloud_ingestion) (CDI),[Zero-Copy Triggers](https://www.braze.com/docs/user_guide/data/unification/cloud_ingestion/zero_copy_sync) , Data Transformation, and more.


What does that look like in practice? Consider[Dyn Media](https://www.braze.com/customers/dyn-media-case-study) , a sports content platform created by sports fans for sports fans that shows what shared context makes possible. After the 2024 European Handball Championship, half of the customers who joined on monthly plans canceled within the first month, resulting in a lower retention and customer lifetime value. Dyn Media connected Snowflake to Braze through Cloud Data Ingestion, bringing in each customer's active subscriptions, most-watched sports, and viewing habits to build precise segments. With that context, the team ran an A/B-tested winback email for lapsed monthly subscribers and a recurring email campaign that gave annual subscribers unique voucher codes to extend their plans. The result? A 10% re-engagement rate from winback campaigns, an 80% unique open rate on the extension campaign, and 75% of targeted users extending their subscriptions after three waves.


Composability also means your engagement data won’t get stuck in one place. Every team should work on the same customer context no matter which tools they are working in. Braze enables that through[Braze Currents](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-currents-data-transfers) ,[Snowflake Secure Data Sharing](https://www.braze.com/docs/partners/data_and_analytics/data_warehouses/snowflake/data_sharing) , and[Databricks Openshare](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-databricks-middleware-tax) *(formerly DeltaShare)* to send high-volume data to your warehouse, business analytics, or other solutions, so your whole organization is operating on the same shared context.


### Enhance interoperability with an open ecosystem and composable intelligence


The Braze platform's focus on data agility extends beyond our own solution and includes an ongoing commitment to supporting integrations with leading composable technologies.[Braze Alloys](https://www.braze.com/partners) is an ever-expanding, open, and flexible MarTech ecosystem of 180+ Braze partners, including data warehouses, CDPs, analytics solutions, AdTech platforms, and other must-have components of a composable MarTech stack.


More than 2,400 customers use these integrations today, spanning data warehouses like Snowflake and Databricks, storage tools like Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage, and commerce platforms like Shopify and commercetools. By blending powerful, extensible APIs with out-of-the-box integrations with leading data and marketing technology solutions, Braze helps brands consistently deliver meaningful, contextually relevant experiences to their customers.


Additionally, BrazeAI™ is built on the philosophy of[composable intelligence](https://www.braze.com/product/brazeai) : the ability to mix and match AI models and agents, whether built by Braze or brought in from providers you already trust, across every layer of the architecture. You can compose and combine AI agents from Braze or bring the models and agents you already use across the platform for faster, more productive work through[Braze Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/braze-mcp-server) and[Operator Connect](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/operator-connect-product-spotlight) . You can also match the right AI decisioning models to their highest-value use cases, giving teams the flexibility to execute 1:1 personalization at scale.


[BookBeat](https://www.braze.com/customers/bookbeat) is one of Europe's leading streaming services for audiobooks and e-books. They needed to optimize their operational efficiency to drive more advanced personalization. BookBeat took advantage of the Braze MCP server to allow marketers to access Braze campaigns and Canvas data within Claude. Their growth marketing team now easily pulls cross-market performance data, creates on-brand interactive dashboards, and ships final reports from within Claude while cutting reporting time by more than 99%.


### Scalable platform that grows with your needs


[In 2025](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/2025-how-braze-powered-exceptional-marketing-at-scale) , Braze processed 25 trillion data points, fueling 4.5 trillion messages and Canvas actions, made 3.1 trillion decisioning inferences that contributed to 17.9 billion AI decisions, and observed an approximately 33% increase in the number of API-triggered messaging campaigns. The Braze platform is designed to scale up and down with demand, so your biggest moments like a holiday season sale get the same performance as an ordinary Tuesday.


Scale also shows up in how far a brand can grow without losing the personal touch. Already in 24 different markets with plans to move into 20 more markets within just 3 years,[Storytel](https://www.braze.com/customers/storytel-case-study) was beginning to feel the growing pains from their success and wanted to evolve their current marketing strategy that could empower their different teams across the world. They created personalized customer journeys for their subscribers using Braze to deliver meaningful messages at scale to their customers across the globe resulting in 1.5 million users across the globe.


## Build the stack that fits your business


Whatever the future holds for customer engagement, that future will be built on a foundation of composability. Braze is committed to a composable ecosystem that gives you flexibility across your data, tools, and partners. However you design your tech stack, Braze is built to support your approach and grow with it.


To further explore what fully composable and mixed stacks look like in practice, get[The marketer's guide to composable tech stacks](https://www.braze.com/resources/reports-and-guides/composability-marketing-tech-stack-guide/) .
